banner.title: Build Your Custom Crypto Wallet App
banner.content: Launch a secure, multi-chain crypto wallet with custom features, DeFi integrations, and enterprise-grade security. We design non-custodial, custodial, and MPC wallets tailored to your business model and user needs.

about.title: From Simple Storage to Complete Web3 Ecosystem
about.content: Basic crypto wallets focus on send/receive functionality. Modern wallet development combines multi-chain support, in-wallet swaps, staking, NFT management, dApp browser, and fiat on-ramps.Build a proprietary wallet that gives users complete control over their assets while accessing the full DeFi ecosystem, earning rewards, and managing digital collectibles from a single interface.

cardSectionOne.title: Your Users Need Security. Your Wallet Should Deliver Trust.
cardSectionOne.description: Crypto users demand seamless multi-chain experiences with bank-level security. Building a wallet from scratch requires blockchain expertise, security audits, key management systems, and compliance with app store guidelines.

content.paraTxt: Private key management, encryption, and anti-phishing measures require specialized blockchain security expertise.
Supporting 50+ blockchains and thousands of tokens requires extensive development and ongoing maintenance.
Meeting KYC/AML, MiCA, and jurisdiction-specific requirements demands legal and technical expertise.
Custom wallet development requires significant investment in security audits, blockchain integrations, and UX design.

cardSectionOne.finalPoint: Professional crypto wallet development solves these challenges with battle-tested security architecture, pre-integrated chains, and compliance-ready modules.

cardSectionTwo.title: Custom Wallets Designed Around Your Vision
cardSectionTwo.description: Every wallet project has unique requirements based on target users, supported chains, and business model. We build tailored solutions from the ground up with full ownership and scalability.

content.paraTxt: Build a self-custody wallet where users control private keys with seed phrase backup and biometric authentication.
Develop a managed wallet with centralized custody, KYC onboarding, fiat on-ramps, and institutional-grade security.
Implement multi-party computation technology for enhanced security without single points of failure.
Support Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, BNB Chain, and 50+ other blockchains in a single app.
Integrate token swaps, staking, yield farming, and dApp browser for complete DeFi access.
Launch quickly with customizable white-label software including multi-chain support and NFT gallery.

clickableSec.title: Turn Wallet Ideas Into Live Web3 Apps
clickableSec.description: Whether you're targeting traders, DeFi users, NFT collectors, or institutions, our wallet solutions support diverse use cases and business models.

content.paraTxt: Enable in-wallet swaps via DEX aggregators like 1inch, Uniswap, or Jupiter for seamless trading.
Offer passive income opportunities with built-in staking modules for supported chains and tokens.
Display, manage, and trade NFTs with marketplace integration and collection tracking.
Integrate payment gateways like MoonPay, Transak, or Stripe for users to buy crypto with cards.
Allow users to explore and interact with DeFi apps, games, and marketplaces directly from the wallet.
Enable seamless asset transfers across different blockchains with integrated bridge protocols.

devProc.title: From Concept Design to App Store Launch
devProc.description: We follow a structured process to design, build, audit, and deploy your wallet with enterprise-grade security and user experience.

content.paraTxt: We analyze your target users, supported chains, features, compliance needs, and monetization strategy.
We define wallet type, key management system, blockchain integrations, security layers, and UX flows.
We develop wallet creation, send/receive, token management, swaps, staking, and user interfaces.
We connect blockchains, DEXs, payment gateways, price feeds, and third-party APIs.
We perform security audits, penetration testing, smart contract reviews, and QA across all modules.
We publish on iOS and Android stores, provide ongoing maintenance, and add new chains and features.

table.title: Custom Development vs White-Label Solutions
table.description: Choosing between custom wallet development and white-label solutions depends on your timeline, budget, and long-term vision.
table.finalPoint: White-label wallets work for quick MVPs and market testing, while custom development is essential for building a scalable, differentiated wallet product.

cardSectionThree.title: Make Web3 Access Part of Your Business
cardSectionThree.description: A well-built wallet accelerates your entry into the crypto market while providing competitive advantages through unique features and superior user experience.

content.paraTxt: Earn from swap fees, staking spreads, premium features, and transaction fees.
Attract crypto users with a branded wallet that becomes their gateway to Web3.
Build your own brand with full control over UX, features, and market positioning.
Stand out with unique features like exclusive chains, integrated DeFi, or NFT utilities.
Own your codebase, intellectual property, and platform for long-term valuation.
Create a wallet that serves as the foundation for your broader Web3 products and services.

cardSectionFour.title: We Build Wallets Around Your Business Goals
cardSectionFour.description: Our wallet development is not one-size-fits-all. We tailor every module to align with your target market, security requirements, and revenue model.

content.paraTxt: Multi-layer security with encryption, biometrics, MPC options, and third-party audits.
Intuitive UX for both crypto beginners and advanced users with seamless onboarding.
Built with APIs, WalletConnect v2, and modular design for easy feature additions.
Integrate KYC/AML, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting as needed.

qnsAns.qns: 2. How much does it cost to build a crypto wallet?
qnsAns.ans: White-label wallets cost $25k–$50k. Custom non-custodial wallets range from $80k–$150k. Enterprise wallets with MPC, DeFi, and compliance can exceed $300k.
White-label: 2–6 weeks. Custom MVP: 3–5 months. Full-featured wallet with DeFi and NFTs: 6–9 months depending on complexity.

qnsAns.qns: 6. How many blockchains can be supported?
qnsAns.ans: Custom wallets can support unlimited chains. Typical multi-chain wallets integrate 50–100+ blockchains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and Layer 2s.

qnsAns.qns: 7. Does it support NFTs and DeFi?
qnsAns.ans: Yes. NFT galleries, marketplace integration, token swaps, staking, and dApp browsers are standard features in modern wallet development.
